source: instinct-aventure (note 89 ; ciel austral, route aux acacias, bivouac, plateau, dunes : 8 images régénérées puis validées, sections notées 4-5), tiki-cassis (crique, lever de soleil, coque, cordage), hanamizuki, willowcamp, games42 (portails, « zéro frayeur »), talon-libre ; échecs gdreseau (pitons étrangers au lieu) et apasdechien (ville hors contexte).
style: Cinematic documentary travel photograph, full-frame camera, 35mm lens, {ambiance} mood, palette of {palette}, {lumiere}, tactile {matieres}, set in {lieu} on {saison}, soft natural contrast, subtle fine film grain, calm minimal composition with generous negative space, photorealistic, high detail.
interdits: No tourists' faces, no boat names, no vehicle, no road sign, no painted text on the road, no famous landmark, no postcard cliché, no place presented as the client's real site.
evite: Évite le paysage qui ne ressemble pas au lieu (pitons tropicaux, promenade méditerranéenne) : décrire le relief, la végétation et la lumière propres au lieu, et exclure les voisins photogéniques.

404.consigne: An open field notebook with blank pages, a compass and a pencil on a weathered wooden table, the needle pointing nowhere in particular, warm light, a gentle touch of humour.
404.evite: La carte lisible avec de vrais noms.

ouverture.consigne: Straight empty road disappearing toward the horizon through {sujet}, early morning light, soft haze, low camera angle close to the road surface, no vehicles, no road signs, no painted text on the road, no people.
ouverture.evite: La voiture de location et les panneaux.

section-fond.consigne: Night sky over {lieu}, the Milky Way arching across a deep blue-black sky full of stars, low hills as a dark silhouette on the horizon, a small warm campfire glow far away, the lower third stays dark and simple for text overlay, no people.
section-fond.evite: Le ciel chargé sous le formulaire.

scene-metier.consigne: A simple campsite at dusk under a large old tree, a small crackling campfire, two folding camp chairs, an old metal lantern glowing on a wooden table, landscape fading into blue twilight, first stars appearing, no vehicles, no tents with logos, no people.

lieu.consigne: Late afternoon view of {sujet}, warm low sun lighting the relief, typical vegetation of {lieu} in the foreground, clear pale sky, wild and untouched, no buildings, no roads, no people; {lieu} only, no postcard clichés.

texture.consigne: Close-up of {matieres}, warm tones, glossy reflections, soft morning side light, shallow depth of field, no names, no lettering.

portrait-generique.consigne: A single traveller seen from behind and far away, small in the frame, walking along an empty shore in soft morning mist, silhouette only, face never visible.
